a: $8,354 for 10 weeks plus a $2,000 on-campus housing supplement
dt: Applications and two recommendation letters due on or before Jan 8, 2027
e: A 10-week summer research program at Caltech (June 14 to August 20, 2027) for sophomores, juniors and non-graduating seniors in STEM who plan to pursue a PhD, with a Caltech faculty mentor. Applicants must be US citizens, permanent residents or DACA recipients, have a GPA of at least 3.4 and have prior research experience.
unv: The application page gives the deadline as January 8 without a year; it is the deadline for the 2027 program (June 14 to August 20, 2027). It previously gave January 9.
